text:
maya: heads-up — SDK publish for the sample-app onboarding hit CI failures during the release gate. regen-diff shows a property reordering in the generated types and a minor semver bump from typegen.
ci-bot: build #4821 failed: publish-step -> exit code 1. logs: https://ci.example.com/4821 ▸ npm ERR! audit fix needed
jason: link to the artifact? can we reproduce locally?
samir: pasted the diff:```diff
-  interface User { lastLogin?: string; firstName: string }
+  interface User { firstName: string; lastLogin?: string }
```Looks like stable sort drifted from openapi->typegen pipeline (non-deterministic example ordering).
leah: also seeing auth/retry e2e flakes in sample-app tests — retries aren't idempotent with our current test harness so publish step times out intermittently.
ben: probable root causes: (1) typegen unstable sort -> regen diffs causing semver to bump, (2) changelog automation picks up the semver and tries to publish a new minor, (3) e2e retry flakiness prevents gated publish.
maya: can we triage quickly? temporary mitigation idea: pin typegen hash in publish CI, force stableSort in the generator, and make changelog generator ignore regen-only diffs.
samir: repro steps I used: `git checkout staging && ./scripts/regenerate.sh && git diff --name-only` -> outputs `src/types/user.ts`. local regen with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=4096 node ./tools/typegen/index.js --stable-sort` made the ordering consistent.
jason: we should add a CI check: fail if regen produces any diff unless a changelog bump PR includes a manual approval. simple binary check: `git diff --exit-code generated/ || echo "regen-diff"` in CI and fail.
leah: I'll open a small PR to flip the test harness to use idempotent retry simulation (wrap the mocked downstream in a deterministic backoff). assign to @leah.
ben: for semver, recommend treating regen-only diffs as patch-level by default and only allow minors/major bumps when changelog has meaningful content. that avoids accidental minor publishes.
maya: agree. can someone own: (A) CI regen-gate check, (B) typegen stable-sort flag default, (C) changelog filter rule.
samir: I'll take (B) and open a PR with `--stable-sort` enabled and a changelog note.
leah: I got (C) — will add logic to exclude commits with `chore(typegen): regen` from triggering auto-minor.
ben: I'll draft the CI gate (A) and wire it to the publish job so it adds a `regen-diff` label instead of publishing.
devex-bot: created issue #987: "regen diffs causing accidental semver bumps + flaky publish" and linked CI failure https://ci.example.com/4821.
maya: awesome — once PRs exist let's coordinate a small canary publish to staging, then merge. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
ci-bot: rerun queued: job #4822 started by jason (reproduce job).
maya: leaving notes in the release runbook about the temporary pin and the owner list.
